routines.fixtureRationale: Existing LSK/SPK provenance and authored text fixtures are documented in fixtures/README.md. Meta templates and filesystem/boundary inputs are authored in tests and always removed in finally. No new scientific datasets.
routines.cleanup: Each registered workflow runs kclear/reset before the case, finalizers then kclear/reset after success/error, and disposes the actual backend. Node retains staged bytes through unload/partial failures, then removes files and the owned root on kclear. WASM virtual files remain backend-owned; query withAllocs cleanup is fault-injected at every allocation. Supplemental native/WASM tests use try/finally for raw kclear, backend dispose and scratch removal. kxtrct owns only bounded temporary native/JS buffers.
routines.tolerance: No floating-output tolerance change: kernel counts/indices/booleans/types/strings are exact; relative path hierarchy is preserved. Opaque absolute handles differ by process and are observed through text/meta zero versus binary nonzero and within-runtime metadata correspondence. Authored small pool values and 32-bit endpoints are exactly representable; existing 1e-12 comparator is adequate. kxtrct strings are byte-content-equivalent Unicode strings including significant whitespace.

routines.semantics: Clear the loaded kernel table and kernel-pool variables; repeated calls are harmless. This operation does not erase every CSPICE subsystem setting (for example time defaults/watch registrations).

scenarios.observes: kclear clears previously loaded kernels from the kernel database Counts, metadata misses and pool absence after actual raw clear reach the assertions; later load shows usable state.

Clear removes both registrations and user pool values and supports repeated clear/reload. Counts, metadata misses and pool absence after actual raw clear reach the assertions; later load shows usable state.

routines.semantics: Return a zero-based position in the selected loaded-kernel table, preserving loaded order, filename, type, source and backend-local metadata handle. Negative or out-of-range signed integer indices miss. Contract selectors add filename-inferred text subtypes and OR arrays.

routines.edgeAssessment: Compare every metadata field with fixture-relative path hierarchy, text/binary handle-zero distinctions and selected ordering. Negative/end misses and scalar/union/subtype/default filters have distinct counts and entries. Meta source attribution is independently compared in supplemental live tests.
routines.errorAssessment: Unknown kinds are explicit public-contract errors (independent oracle validates the same declared selector set, then calls real CSPICE for ordinary kinds). Fractional/nonfinite/wrapped indices are rejected before FFI conversion. Every one of seven WASM allocation failure positions is checked for rollback.
